policy.max_patches_per_run: as many independent source-grounded complete patches as execution resources permit
policy.verification: local execution and independent evidence required
policy.local_selection: Check actual DT HEAD and git status --porcelain for target paths BEFORE choosing or executing an .sh. Separate committed source drift from uncommitted changes, and check whether idea is already implemented. Try git apply --check on actual worktree; if hunks compatible, apply preserving independent changes, then guarded tests. If overlap, do not overwrite or reset; Clai should inspect source/test and minimally integrate the precise behavior, or report exact conflict. Never interpret a local dirty path as proof of remote stale source. Do not select conflicting alternatives (002 versus 010).
policy.mission_decomposition: Every run: enumerate all active mission steps; split eligible implementation into one-file patches; explicitly track blocked, prerequisite, and verification-only steps; rebase pending scripts on latest executor branch.
policy.public_source_disclosure: DT code diff patches are allowed in designated public patches directory; do not publish credentials, protected runtime state, or confidential third-party data.
policy.non_code_scripts: Scripts marked DIAGNOSTIC_READY are independent read-only/isolated verification steps, not implementation patches. Never claim code integration or push for them. They may be selected only when asked to execute diagnostic work.
policy.diagnostic_artifacts: 015-019 are actual executable guarded baseline scripts, not code diffs, and must not be selected as implementation patches.
policy.git_commit: Commit and push only the verified intended DT change on authorized branch; do not stage unrelated pre-existing dirty modifications. Separately publish sanitized result to patch_management/results.
policy.next_patch: Do not auto-choose 002 or 010 until conflict resolved and 010 exact source is validated. New code patches 024 and 025 remain prepared; ensure source compatibility before executing.
policy.directory_contract: patches/ implementation .sh only. Diagnostic-only .sh are legacy and should be migrated to patch_management/diagnostics/ upon authorized safe update.
policy.retirement_contract: Code patches implemented and pushed on DT feature branch are removed from public active patch directory, but retained in index/historical commits/results. Status APPLIED_UNVERIFIED must not be misread as whole-mission Ground or DT/main integration.
policy.active_patch_selector: Only select actual implementation .sh files in doubletake_evolution/patches; 010,024,025 currently prepared and tests not executed. Never select superseded 002 or atomic conditional files in implementation mode.
policy.mainline: DT executor is now branch main at 17c70b0e2b7fec53e46bdeaa35e9e25d76034bd2; former feature/alphacode-provider has been merged or removed. Re-query actual main HEAD on each run.
policy.conditional_patches: 58 atomic mission task packages reside in doubletake_evolution/patch_management/atomic_patches/ as guarded executable prerequisites/verification. These are NOT source-diff implementation patches and MUST NOT be counted as implemented code. Replace them with source-grounded diffs as actual gaps and authorization permit.
